request.system:
An earlier incident on another project may be relevant to a new issue.
Write one plain sentence (at most 30 words) saying why it is relevant and what happened last time, using only the facts given. No speculation.
Return JSON {"explanation": "..."}.
request.user:
New issue (Drumgarve, 2025-05-30): Missing swept path analysis. Contractor has not yet provided the swept path analysis for the traffic management condition, which is required for the planning condition discharge.
Earlier incident (Netherwood, 2024-12-31): Planning condition discharge delay. Construction traffic management plan delayed by the civils contractor, pushing site start. Outcome recorded: Planning condition delays were noted in weekly reports but not escalated due to lack of a formal escalation trigger.

response.explanation: The earlier delay in Netherwood due to a missing traffic management plan highlights the importance of having a swept path analysis for planning condition discharge, which is also missing in Drumgarve.
